content.text:
No. `src/services/user-service.js` still calls `query` and `update` from `../db.js` directly, using callbacks. It doesn't import `UserRepository` anywhere, and a comment in the file (line 3) says the migration hasn't happened yet.

The repository it should switch to, `src/repositories/user-repository.js`, already exists. Each service function has a promise-based equivalent there:

| `user-service.js` (callback) | `UserRepository` (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(callback)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, callback)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, callback)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project has a `migrate-module` skill for exactly this: it moves one service file onto its repository and runs that file's tests. I can run it on `user-service.js` if you want.
